_source.title: 缩放多边形
_source.params.scaleY: Y 方向缩放比例，默认与 scaleX 相同
_source.params.centerX: 缩放中心 X 坐标，默认为质心
_source.params.centerY: 缩放中心 Y 坐标，默认为质心

title: Scale the polygon
params.scaleY: Y direction scale ratio, defaulting to the same as scaleX
params.centerX: X coordinate of the scaling center, defaulting to the centroid
params.centerY: Y coordinate of the scaling center, defaulting to the centroid
returns: Array of discrete points after scaling
